label: Core
description: Code-backed platform primitives: triggers, agents, generic tools, control flow, outputs. Executed by apps/reasoner/reasoner/nodes.py, not the generic integration runtime.

nodes.label: Manual trigger
nodes.description: Start the workflow on demand; seeds the run input downstream.
nodes.search: start manual run on demand trigger begin

nodes.label: Schedule trigger
nodes.description: Run on a cron schedule (e.g. every weekday at 9am).
nodes.search: schedule cron daily hourly recurring timer trigger

nodes.label: AI agent
nodes.description: Reason over upstream outputs with a large language model. The workhorse for research, synthesis, extraction, transformation and summarization.
nodes.search: ai llm agent reason summarize synthesize extract classify write analyze transform parse

nodes.label: HTTP request
nodes.description: Call any public URL. Carries no stored credentials; imported API nodes do.
nodes.search: http api rest get post fetch request call url json rss feed

nodes.label: If / Else
nodes.description: Gate: evaluate a condition; when false, the entire downstream subgraph is skipped.
nodes.search: if else branch condition gate compare decide

nodes.label: Filter
nodes.description: Gate: pass the flow through only when the condition holds; otherwise skip downstream.
nodes.search: filter condition keep when rule gate

nodes.label: Loop
nodes.description: Fan out: resolve a list and run the downstream branch once per item. Inside the body, {{item}} is the current element and {{loop.<key>.index}} the position; collected results appear as outputs.<key>.results.
nodes.search: loop foreach iterate items map fan out each repeat

nodes.label: Human approval
nodes.description: Pause the run until a person approves. If rejected, everything downstream is skipped.
nodes.search: approval review human confirm sign off pause gate
